title: Krylov complexity from a simple quantum mechanical model for a radiating black hole
summary: We investigate Krylov complexity in a simple quantum mechanical model describing a black hole coupled to its radiation. The model is constructed as a simplified ``mini-BMN" matrix system inspired by a recent proposal of Maldacena. Our aim is not to reproduce the full dynamics of the BMN matrix model, but rather to isolate a tractable setting in which the information-theoretic behaviour of a radiating black hole can be studied explicitly.
